$comment: Landing is a performance showcase: gzip KB over every emitted client chunk. Static pages with only three client islands (theme provider, locale picker, FAQ accordion), so the budget is a fraction of the app's (app: 905 KB total). Values are STARTING LIMITS set before the first build (UNVERIFIED): run `next build`, measure with the shared check-bundle-size script, then ratchet down to ~3% above the measured baseline. Never raise them to make CI pass.
